title: Why You Spend Tax Refunds Faster Than Paychecks (Mental Accounting)
alt_title_1: Nobel Winner Richard Thaler's $1,000 Windfall Trap Explained
alt_title_2: Why 'Bonus Money' Vanishes 3x Faster Than Your Salary
description_hook: A dollar is a dollar, yet human brains treat a $1,000 tax refund completely differently than a $1,000 paycheck. Here is Nobel laureate Richard Thaler's Mental Accounting discovery and the 14-day Fungibility Rule to stop windfall leaks.

scenes.headline: Same $1,000 - Two Opposite Behaviors
bullets: Hard-earned salary gets protected down to the cent
Identical tax refunds or bonuses vanish within days
scenes.narration: Hand someone a thousand-dollar paycheck and they guard every cent. Hand that exact same person a thousand-dollar tax refund and half of it vanishes by Sunday.

scenes.headline: Richard Thaler's Nobel Discovery (2017)
bullets: Coined 'Mental Accounting' after studying household budgets
Your brain tags identical cash with fake emotional labels
scenes.narration: Economist Richard Thaler won the Nobel Prize for proving why. He called it Mental Accounting. Even though money is completely interchangeable, your brain tags every dollar with an emotional story.

scenes.headline: Why 'Found Money' Numbs Spending Caution
scenes.left_body: Bonus or refund -> tagged 'house money' -> impulse upgrades
scenes.right_body: Every $1 carries identical future compounding power
scenes.narration: Salary dollars feel heavy because you traded forty hours of stress to earn them. Refund or bonus dollars feel weightless - like house money - so spending friction disappears.

scenes.headline: The 14-Day Fungibility Quarantine
scenes.narration: Use the Fungibility Rule: park every bonus, gift, or tax refund in savings for fourteen days until the windfall rush fades. Then ask if you would buy that upgrade using overtime pay.

scenes.headline: Strip the Fake Label Off Every Dollar
bullets: Quarantine windfalls for 14 days before touching a cent
Judge every purchase in hours of real sweat equity
scenes.narration: Once you strip the fake label off your cash, every windfall starts compounding like real wealth. Because without that reset...
